svg.title: Ycoor Street View camera coverage
svg.desc: Viewer URL-reported camera locations and viewer-reported headings. Blue circles identify Google Street View; purple diamonds identify third-party photo spheres. Physical GPS accuracy and heading calibration are unverified, especially third-party orientation. Dashed rectangle is project context. Enumeration is incomplete. No building footprints are inferred.

g.text: Viewer URL-reported positions and headings. Incomplete enumeration; no basemap or inferred footprints.
